svg.title: The ZEN ecosystem — system map
svg.desc: Arsenal, ZEN AI Arena, Qubit and AI Pioneer orbit the ZEN core; ZEN Pen, Vibe Book, Agent Viz, ZEN Avatar, Analytics, Life-in-Time, Periodic and Physics form the studio ring; Solutions, Tools, Challenges, Leaderboard, ZEN Weekly, Blog, Media Hub, Groups, Discord and Telegram form the community ring.
svg.text: + 10 more across community, media and research
